title: Fix DSPy agent multi-tool turn loop
description:
Feature: Agent tool loops finalize from tool results

Scenario: An agent calls a tool and then answers
Given a DSPy agent receives a user turn that requires a tool
When the model returns a tool call and then receives the tool result
Then Tactus calls the model again with updated history
And the final assistant answer can use the tool result

Scenario: An agent chains tools before answering
Given a DSPy agent needs multiple tool calls in one user turn
When the model returns more tool calls after a tool result
Then Tactus continues the tool loop
And stops only when the model returns a normal assistant answer

Scenario: A terminal turn has no text
Given the model returns no further tool calls and no usable assistant text
When Tactus detects the missing final answer
Then it performs one explicit final synthesis call from the current history.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Implemented DSPy agent tool-loop fix locally: streaming and non-streaming turns now repeat model calls after tool execution using updated history and blank follow-up user input; forced synthesis is only used when a terminal cycle has no usable text. Live Plexus console smoke verified tool call plus final answer.
